Or the giving of food in a day of privation
يَّتِيۡمًا ذَا مَقۡرَبَةٍۙ‏
To the orphan with claims of relationship
اَوۡ مِسۡكِيۡنًا ذَا مَتۡرَبَةٍؕ‏
Or to the indigent (down) in the dust
ثُمَّ كَانَ مِنَ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَتَوَاصَوۡا بِالصَّبۡرِ وَتَوَاصَوۡا بِالۡمَرۡحَمَةِؕ‏
Then will he be of those who believe, and enjoin patience, (constancy, and self-restraint), and enjoin deeds of kindness and compassion
اُولٰٓئِكَ اَصۡحٰبُ الۡمَيۡمَنَةِؕ‏
Such are the Companions of the Right Hand
وَالَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا بِاٰيٰتِنَا هُمۡ اَصۡحٰبُ الۡمَشۡـَٔمَةِؕ‏
But those who reject Our Signs, they are the (unhappy) Companions of the Left Hand
عَلَيۡهِمۡ نَارٌ مُّؤۡصَدَةٌࣖ‏
On them will be Fire vaulted over (all round)
91: وَالشَّمۡسِ وَضُحٰىهَاۙࣕ‏
By the Sun and his (glorious) splendour
وَالۡقَمَرِ اِذَا تَلٰىهَاۙࣕ‏
By the Moon as she follows him
وَالنَّهَارِ اِذَا جَلّٰىهَاۙࣕ‏
By the Day as it shows up (the Sun's) glory
وَالَّيۡلِ اِذَا يَغۡشٰىهَاۙࣕ‏
By the Night as it conceals it
وَالسَّمَآءِ وَمَا بَنٰىهَاۙࣕ‏
By the Firmament and its (wonderful) structure
وَالۡاَرۡضِ وَمَا طَحٰىهَاۙࣕ‏
By the Earth and its (wide) expanse
وَنَفۡسٍ وَّمَا سَوّٰىهَاۙࣕ‏
By the Soul, and the proportion and order given to it
فَاَلۡهَمَهَا فُجُوۡرَهَا وَتَقۡوٰىهَاۙࣕ‏
And its enlightenment as to its wrong and its right
قَدۡ اَفۡلَحَ مَنۡ زَكّٰىهَاۙࣕ‏
Truly he succeeds that purifies it
وَقَدۡ خَابَ مَنۡ دَسّٰىهَاؕ‏
And he fails that corrupts it
كَذَّبَتۡ ثَمُوۡدُ بِطَغۡوٰىهَا٘ۙࣕ‏
The Thamud (people) rejected (their prophet) through their inordinate wrong-doing
اِذِ انۭۡ بَعَثَ اَشۡقٰىهَاۙࣕ‏
Behold, the most wicked man among them was deputed (for impiety)
فَقَالَ لَهُمۡ رَسُوۡلُ اللّٰهِ نَاقَةَ اللّٰهِ وَسُقۡيٰهَاؕ‏
But the Messenger of Allah said to them: "It is a She-camel of Allah! And (bar her not from) having her drink
فَكَذَّبُوۡهُ فَعَقَرُوۡهَا ࣢ۙࣕ فَدَمۡدَمَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ بِذَنۭۡ بِهِمۡ فَسَوّٰىهَاۙࣕ‏
Then they rejected him (as a false prophet), and they hamstrung her. So their Lord, on account of their crime, obliterated their traces and made them equal (in destruction, high and low)
وَلَا يَخَافُ عُقۡبٰهَاࣖ‏
And for Him is no fear of its consequences
92: وَالَّيۡلِ اِذَا يَغۡشٰيۙ‏
By the Night as it conceals (the light)
وَالنَّهَارِ اِذَا تَجَلّٰيۙ‏
By the Day as it appears in glory
وَمَا خَلَقَ الذَّكَرَ وَالۡاُنۡثٰ٘يۙ‏
By (the mystery of) the creation of male and female
اِنَّ سَعۡيَكُمۡ لَشَتّٰيؕ‏
Verily, (the ends) ye strive for are diverse
فَاَمَّا مَنۡ اَعۡطٰي وَاتَّقٰيۙ‏
So he who gives (in charity) and fears (Allah)
وَصَدَّقَ بِالۡحُسۡنٰيۙ‏
And (in all sincerity) testifies to the best
فَسَنُيَسِّرُهٗ لِلۡيُسۡرٰيؕ‏
We will indeed make smooth for him the path to Bliss
وَاَمَّا مَنۭۡ بَخِلَ وَاسۡتَغۡنٰيۙ‏
But he who is a greedy miser and thinks himself self-sufficient
وَكَذَّبَ بِالۡحُسۡنٰيۙ‏
And gives the lie to the best
فَسَنُيَسِّرُهٗ لِلۡعُسۡرٰيؕ‏
We will indeed make smooth for him the path to Misery
وَمَا يُغۡنِيۡ عَنۡهُ مَالُهٗ٘ اِذَا تَرَدّٰيؕ‏
Nor will his wealth profit him when he falls headlong (into the Pit)
اِنَّ عَلَيۡنَا لَلۡهُدٰيؗۖ‏
Verily We take upon Ourselves to guide
وَاِنَّ لَنَا لَلۡاٰخِرَةَ وَالۡاُوۡلٰي
And verily unto Us (belong) the End and the Beginning
فَاَنۡذَرۡتُكُمۡ نَارًا تَلَظّٰيۚ‏
Therefore do I warn you of a Fire blazing fiercely
لَا يَصۡلٰىهَا٘ اِلَّا الۡاَشۡقَيۙ‏
None shall reach it but those most unfortunate ones
الَّذِيۡ كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلّٰيؕ‏
Who give the lie to Truth and turn their backs
وَسَيُجَنَّبُهَا الۡاَتۡقَيۙ‏
But those most devoted to Allah shall be removed far from it
الَّذِيۡ يُؤۡتِيۡ مَالَهٗ يَتَزَكّٰيۚ‏
Those who spend their wealth for increase in self-purification
وَمَا لِاَحَدٍ عِنۡدَهٗ مِنۡ نِّعۡمَةٍ تُجۡزٰ٘يۙ‏
And have in their minds no favour from anyone for which a reward is expected in return
اِلَّا ابۡتِغَآءَ وَجۡهِ رَبِّهِ الۡاَعۡلٰيۚ‏
But only the desire to seek for the Countenance of their Lord Most High
وَلَسَوۡفَ يَرۡضٰيࣖ‏
And soon will they attain (complete) satisfaction
93: And by the Night when it is still
Thy Guardian-Lord hath not forsaken thee, nor is He displeased
And verily the Hereafter will be better for thee than the present
And soon will thy Guardian-Lord give thee (that wherewith) thou shalt be well-pleased
Did He not find thee an orphan and give thee shelter (and care)
And He found thee wandering, and He gave thee guidance
And He found thee in need, and made thee independent
Therefore, treat not the orphan with harshness
But the bounty of the Lord - rehearse and proclaim
94: Have We not expanded thee thy breast
And removed from thee thy burden
The which did gall thy back
And raised high the esteem (in which) thou (art held)
So, verily, with every difficulty, there is relief
Verily, with every difficulty there is relief
Therefore, when thou art free (from thine immediate task), still labour hard
And to thy Lord turn (all) thy attention
95: By the Fig and the Olive
لَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا الۡاِنۡسَانَ فِيۡ٘ اَحۡسَنِ تَقۡوِيۡمٍؗ‏
We have indeed created man in the best of moulds
Then do We abase him (to be) the lowest of the low
اِلَّا الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ فَلَهُمۡ اَجۡرٌ غَيۡرُ مَمۡنُوۡنٍؕ‏
Except such as believe and do righteous deeds: For they shall have a reward unfailing
Then what can, after this, contradict thee, as to the judgment (to come)
Is not Allah the wisest of judges
96: Proclaim! (or read!) in the name of thy Lord and Cherisher, Who created
Created man, out of a (mere) clot of congealed blood
Proclaim! And thy Lord is Most Bountiful
He Who taught (the use of) the pen
Taught man that which he knew not
Nay, but man doth transgress all bounds
In that he looketh upon himself as self-sufficient
Verily, to thy Lord is the return (of all)
A votary when he (turns) to pray
Seest thou if he is on (the road of) Guidance
Seest thou if he denies (Truth) and turns away
Knoweth he not that Allah doth see
كَلَّا لَئِنۡ لَّمۡ يَنۡتَهِ ࣢ۙ لَنَسۡفَعًاۭ بِالنَّاصِيَةِۙ‏
Let him beware! If he desist not, We will drag him by the forelock
Then, let him call (for help) to his council (of comrades)
We will call on the angels of punishment (to deal with him)
Nay, heed him not: But bow down in adoration, and bring thyself the closer (to Allah)
97: We have indeed revealed this (Message) in the Night of Power
And what will explain to thee what the night of power is
لَيۡلَةُ الۡقَدۡرِ ࣢ۙ خَيۡرٌ مِّنۡ اَلۡفِ شَهۡرٍؕؔ‏
The Night of Power is better than a thousand months
تَنَزَّلُ الۡمَلٰٓئِكَةُ وَالرُّوۡحُ فِيۡهَا بِاِذۡنِ رَبِّهِمۡ مِّنۡ كُلِّ اَمۡرٍۙۛ‏
Therein come down the angels and the Spirit by Allah's permission, on every errand
Peace!... This until the rise of morn
98: لَمۡ يَكُنِ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا مِنۡ اَهۡلِ الۡكِتٰبِ وَالۡمُشۡرِكِيۡنَ مُنۡفَكِّيۡنَ حَتّٰي تَاۡتِيَهُمُ الۡبَيِّنَةُۙ‏
Those who reject (Truth), among the People of the Book and among the Polytheists, were not going to depart (from their ways) until there should come to them Clear Evidence
رَسُوۡلٌ مِّنَ اللّٰهِ يَتۡلُوۡا صُحُفًا مُّطَهَّرَةًۙ‏
An messenger from Allah, rehearsing scriptures kept pure and holy
Wherein are laws (or decrees) right and straight
وَمَا تَفَرَّقَ الَّذِيۡنَ اُوۡتُوا الۡكِتٰبَ اِلَّا مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِ مَا جَآءَتۡهُمُ الۡبَيِّنَةُؕ‏
Nor did the People of the Book make schisms, until after there came to them Clear Evidence
وَمَا٘ اُمِرُوۡ٘ا اِلَّا لِيَعۡبُدُوا اللّٰهَ مُخۡلِصِيۡنَ لَهُ الدِّيۡنَ ࣢ۙ حُنَفَآءَ وَيُقِيۡمُوا الصَّلٰوةَ وَيُؤۡتُوا الزَّكٰوةَ وَذٰلِكَ دِيۡنُ الۡقَيِّمَةِؕ‏

And they have been commanded no more than this: To worship Allah, offering Him sincere devotion, being true (in faith); to establish regular prayer; and to practise regular charity; and that is the Religion Right and Straight
اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا مِنۡ اَهۡلِ الۡكِتٰبِ وَالۡمُشۡرِكِيۡنَ فِيۡ نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ خٰلِدِيۡنَ فِيۡهَاؕ اُولٰٓئِكَ هُمۡ شَرُّ الۡبَرِيَّةِؕ‏
Those who reject (Truth), among the People of the Book and among the Polytheists, will be in Hell-Fire, to dwell therein (for aye). They are the worst of creatures
اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِۙ اُولٰٓئِكَ هُمۡ خَيۡرُ الۡبَرِيَّةِؕ‏
Those who have faith and do righteous deeds,- they are the best of creatures
جَزَآؤُهُمۡ عِنۡدَ رَبِّهِمۡ جَنّٰتُ عَدۡنٍ تَجۡرِيۡ مِنۡ تَحۡتِهَا الۡاَنۡهٰرُ خٰلِدِيۡنَ فِيۡهَا٘ اَبَدًاؕ رَضِيَ اللّٰهُ عَنۡهُمۡ وَرَضُوۡا عَنۡهُؕ ذٰلِكَ لِمَنۡ خَشِيَ رَبَّهٗࣖ‏

Their reward is with Allah: Gardens of Eternity, beneath which rivers flow; they will dwell therein for ever; Allah well pleased with them, and they with Him: all this for such as fear their Lord and Cherisher
99: When the earth is shaken to her (utmost) convulsion
And the earth throws up her burdens (from within)
And man cries (distressed): 'What is the matter with her
On that Day will she declare her tidings
For that thy Lord will have given her inspiration
يَوۡمَئِذٍ يَّصۡدُرُ النَّاسُ اَشۡتَاتًا ࣢ۙ لِّيُرَوۡا اَعۡمَالَهُمۡؕ‏
On that Day will men proceed in companies sorted out, to be shown the deeds that they (had done)
فَمَنۡ يَّعۡمَلۡ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيۡرًا يَّرَهٗؕ‏
Then shall anyone who has done an atom's weight of good, see it
وَمَنۡ يَّعۡمَلۡ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ شَرًّا يَّرَهٗࣖ‏
And anyone who has done an atom's weight of evil, shall see it
100: وَالۡعٰدِيٰتِ ضَبۡحًاۙ‏
By the (Steeds) that run, with panting (breath)
فَالۡمُوۡرِيٰتِ قَدۡحًاۙ‏
And strike sparks of fire
فَالۡمُغِيۡرٰتِ صُبۡحًاۙ‏
And push home the charge in the morning
فَاَثَرۡنَ بِهٖ نَقۡعًاۙ‏
And raise the dust in clouds the while
فَوَسَطۡنَ بِهٖ جَمۡعًاۙ‏
And penetrate forthwith into the midst (of the foe) en masse
اِنَّ الۡاِنۡسَانَ لِرَبِّهٖ لَكَنُوۡدٌۚ‏
Truly man is, to his Lord, ungrateful
وَاِنَّهٗ عَلٰي ذٰلِكَ لَشَهِيۡدٌۚ‏
And to that (fact) he bears witness (by his deeds)
وَاِنَّهٗ لِحُبِّ الۡخَيۡرِ لَشَدِيۡدٌؕ‏
And violent is he in his love of wealth
اَفَلَا يَعۡلَمُ اِذَا بُعۡثِرَ مَا فِي الۡقُبُوۡرِۙ‏
Does he not know,- when that which is in the graves is scattered abroad
وَحُصِّلَ مَا فِي الصُّدُوۡرِۙ‏
And that which is (locked up) in (human) breasts is made manifest
اِنَّ رَبَّهُمۡ بِهِمۡ يَوۡمَئِذٍ لَّخَبِيۡرٌࣖ‏
That their Lord had been Well-acquainted with them, (even to) that Day
101: What is the (Day) of Noise and Clamour
And what will explain to thee what the (Day) of Noise and Clamour is
(It is) a Day whereon men will be like moths scattered about
And the mountains will be like carded wool
Then, he whose balance (of good deeds) will be (found) heavy
Will be in a life of good pleasure and satisfaction
But he whose balance (of good deeds) will be (found) light
Will have his home in a (bottomless) Pit
And what will explain to thee what this is
102: The mutual rivalry for piling up (the good things of this world) diverts you (from the more serious things)
But nay, ye soon shall know (the reality)
Nay, were ye to know with certainty of mind, (ye would beware)
Again, ye shall see it with certainty of sight
Then, shall ye be questioned that Day about the joy (ye indulged in)
103: By (the Token of) Time (through the ages)
اِلَّا الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ وَتَوَاصَوۡا بِالۡحَقِّ ࣢ۙ وَتَوَاصَوۡا بِالصَّبۡرِࣖ‏
Except such as have Faith, and do righteous deeds, and (join together) in the mutual teaching of Truth, and of Patience and Constancy
104: Woe to every (kind of) scandal-monger and-backbiter
Who pileth up wealth and layeth it by
Thinking that his wealth would make him last for ever
By no means! He will be sure to be thrown into That which Breaks to Pieces
And what will explain to thee That which Breaks to Pieces
(It is) the Fire of (the Wrath of) Allah kindled (to a blaze)
The which doth mount (Right) to the Hearts
It shall be made into a vault over them
105: اَلَمۡ تَرَ كَيۡفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِاَصۡحٰبِ الۡفِيۡلِؕ‏
Seest thou not how thy Lord dealt with the Companions of the Elephant
Did He not make their treacherous plan go astray
And He sent against them Flights of Birds
Striking them with stones of baked clay
Then did He make them like an empty field of stalks and straw, (of which the corn) has been eaten up
106: For the covenants (of security and safeguard enjoyed) by the Quraish
Their covenants (covering) journeys by winter and summer
Let them adore the Lord of this House
الَّذِيۡ٘ اَطۡعَمَهُمۡ مِّنۡ جُوۡعٍ ࣢ۙ وَّاٰمَنَهُمۡ مِّنۡ خَوۡفٍࣖ‏
Who provides them with food against hunger, and with security against fear (of danger)
107: Seest thou one who denies the Judgment (to come)
Then such is the (man) who repulses the orphan (with harshness)
And encourages not the feeding of the indigent
Who are neglectful of their prayers
Those who (want but) to be seen (of men)
108: To thee have We granted the Fount (of Abundance)
Therefore to thy Lord turn in Prayer and Sacrifice
For he who hateth thee, he will be cut off (from Future Hope)
109: Say: O ye that reject Faith
I worship not that which ye worship
Nor will ye worship that which I worship
And I will not worship that which ye have been wont to worship
Nor will ye worship that which I worship
To you be your Way, and to me mine
110: When comes the Help of Allah, and Victory
وَرَاَيۡتَ النَّاسَ يَدۡخُلُوۡنَ فِيۡ دِيۡنِ اللّٰهِ اَفۡوَاجًاۙ‏
And thou dost see the people enter Allah's Religion in crowds
فَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ وَاسۡتَغۡفِرۡهُؕؔ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ تَوَّابًاࣖ‏
Celebrate the praises of thy Lord, and pray for His Forgiveness: For He is Oft-Returning (in Grace and Mercy)
111: Perish the hands of the Father of Flame! Perish he
مَا٘ اَغۡنٰي عَنۡهُ مَالُهٗ وَمَا كَسَبَؕ‏
No profit to him from all his wealth, and all his gains
Burnt soon will he be in a Fire of Blazing Flame
His wife shall carry the (crackling) wood - As fuel
A twisted rope of palm-leaf fibre round her (own) neck
112: Say: He is Allah, the One and Only
He begetteth not, nor is He begotten
And there is none like unto Him
113: Say: I seek refuge with the Lord of the Dawn
From the mischief of created things
From the mischief of Darkness as it overspreads
From the mischief of those who practise secret arts
And from the mischief of the envious one as he practises envy
114: Say: I seek refuge with the Lord and Cherisher of Mankind
From the mischief of the Whisperer (of Evil), who withdraws (after his whisper)
(The same) who whispers into the hearts of Mankind
